summary.intent: Push a docs-only branch tracking large-file refactor candidates to GitHub, open a PR, then resolve automated reviewer comments on that PR.
summary.outcome: PR #517 opened on cipher-box (docs/large-file-refactor-todo → main); two Greptile review threads resolved by completing the frontmatter `files:` list and removing an ambiguous `read_ops.rs` entry from the Leave-as-is section.

repo: .planning/ is excluded from markdownlint by design (`--ignore .planning` in lint-staged); prettier still runs on those files via the hook
CodeRabbit was rate-limited on this PR; Greptile was the active automated reviewer instead
The `gh pr edit` command fails for Projects-classic on this repo — PR body must be set at creation time via `gh pr create --body`
The release bot (release-please) pushes a `chore(release)` commit onto open branches, requiring a `git fetch` + rebase before further edits

code.finding: Frontmatter `files:` list was incomplete (missing entries for all 26 surveyed files); fixed in review-fix commit. Also had an ambiguous `read_ops.rs` entry in Leave-as-is that duplicated a Tier 2 item — removed.

workflow: Background commit timeouts (exit 124) can be false negatives — verify the commit hash directly rather than retrying
For docs-only markdown changes in .planning/, skip pnpm typecheck/test and markdownlint; the commit can go straight through

friction: `gh pr edit` fails for Projects-classic on this repo, requiring body to be passed at PR creation time
Background commit reported exit 124 (timeout) even though the commit landed successfully — caused momentary confusion
CodeRabbit was rate-limited, so Greptile handled automated review instead — tool availability is inconsistent
open_items: Branch docs/large-file-refactor-todo is local-only until pushed (was pushed in this session); PR #517 awaits merge
The large-file refactor candidates documented in the todo are deferred work — the .planning file tracks them as pending
